requirements.notes: Sections 1.1-1.5: four species classes, origin kinds breeds/spawned/created/unique (DEC-014 §5) with a default-by-SRD-type table, stage tables, SRD Age text for all nine races next to the code profiles (DEUS_HistoricalDemographics.js:128-136), closed-form aging with a due-date queue, and keep/replace for REP-1 and REP-5. Human values follow V123; the V123-vs-SRD mismatch is OQ-W-01. Animal lifespans are zoology defaults (SRD silent).

Sections 2.1-2.4: parent-link records (life block 56 B, ancestor stub 32 B, lineage summary 48 B), bounded kin queries, compaction rule (3 generations, NOTABLE/HISTORY kept) with growth arithmetic, people genome and herd trait means, households, and the feed to history. The history-born mode is undefined in the repo (O2 G8-6), so only its data feed is given.

Sections 3.1-3.6: pairing without population-driven chances, gestation/litter/spacing parameters, the growth/waste/metabolism mass split anchored on the SRD 1 lb food and 1 gallon water rules (rules.json:4403), a ledger table for every step, the soil-nutrient pools, livestock, and explicit interface assumptions IA-R1..R3 (Lane R decay) and IA-Q1..Q2 (Lane Q support). Gestation values where the SRD is silent are OQ-W-07.

Sections 4.1-4.6: caps removed, per-region capacity record (48 B, change-driven), four ratios with SRD anchors (food, water, size categories), SRD-derived famine arithmetic, shelter headroom in 2 ft slices, per-band table keyed by biome, famine/disease/predation/exposure/logistics mechanisms. PARTIAL because forage productivity, predation attack and handling constants and the allometric intake exponent have no SRD or repository source; they are tuning parameters pinned by tests T-CAP-1/T-CAP-2, and vegetation supply depends on SIM.50.04, which does not exist yet.

Sections 5.1-5.5: nine slots with SRD and catalog line numbers, size, speed, darkvision and ability increases (four catalog stats differ from the SRD: D-08-17), population-relevant traits, the PLAN-4 reconciliation (4 matching cultures, 5 missing, 3 non-SRD from PEOPLES.md's eleven), plan-schema inputs for SOC.10.02-03. Everything tagged [D-6]; home ranges kept OPEN and the catalog factions.layers map treated as a stale stand-in. The slot list itself is OQ-W-04.

Sections 6.1-6.6: fine/abstract/bucket records, sparse bucket keys with masses and lineage tables, promotion and demotion rules with an exact conservation table (counts, mass, lineage, tracked set, Q-FACTPOP), owned-herd proposal, budget arithmetic. PARTIAL because the individual budget numbers await post-split benchmarks (ADR-003 §9.2 PENDING-K3) and people crowd LOD awaits the Owner (ADR-003 Q14, DEC-014 OPEN; OQ-W-03, OQ-W-05). Depends on ADR-003, which is PROPOSED.

Ten dependencies M-1..M-10 with the row that provides each: movement model (MIG-1, SIM.00.04), herd entity (MIG-2), seasons (SIM.50.06, blocked on D-1), regions (SIM.30.01-02), capacity pressure (this design), cross-layer travel under soft home ranges (DEC-013 §6, WG.00.17, WG.62.02), refugees and founding (SIM.50.09, SOC.10.02), immigration without creation, and the ledger (WG.65.15).

26 items D-08-01..D-08-26 with file:line at the base commit, LIVE/DORMANT state, gap ID and keep/reactivate/replace/remove recommendation, covering REP-1..5, MIG-1, the 200-per-faction cap (DEUS_Colonists.js:2315 live, :2886 dormant), the 180 immigration cap, capFor, creation-from-nothing in attemptSpawn and spawnImmigrants, and catalog data defects.

Sections 9.1-9.2: published events and read-only queries, consumed health contracts with defaults when no health package loads, SRD exhaustion levels (rules.json:10533), a closed cause vocabulary. No health system is designed.

Sections 10.1-10.3: bytes per record with allocation rule and arithmetic, per-area 32-layer wildlife memory against a rejected dense grid, stale-model note, CPU class per mechanism with trigger, and the saved-versus-rebuilt split for D-3. All figures are arithmetic under stated assumptions; nothing was measured.
16 automatable tests (T-LIFE-1..2, T-MASS-1..3, T-CAP-1..2, T-LIN-1..2, T-LOD-1..3, T-RACE-1..2, T-NOSCAN-1, T-D1-1), each with a fixture, an assertion and a mutant that must fail.

PROPOSED-W-01..W-10 with real dependency IDs and tests; suggested dependency changes to SIM.40.10, SIM.50.07, SIM.50.09, SIM.30.01, SIM.30.03 and WG.62.02; sequencing against audit §6. Owner questions OQ-W-01..OQ-W-11 are under '## Owner questions' with options and are not answered.
